atoms.text: A search engine is a program that you can open in a browser. Using a search engine, you can browse the internet.

atoms.a: Where can you open a search engine?
What can you use a search engine for?

instruction.text: Most search engines have a search bar, into which you can enter your search.

After entering a search, the search engine creates a list of relevant <t-blue>links</t-blue>. The links are usually <t-blue>blue</t-blue> and will take you to different websites. Select all the blue <t-blue>links</t-blue>.
Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Search engines are free for us to use, but the providers still need to make money, so they sell advertising space to other companies.
